description: The standard JSON error document of RFC 9457, sent as application/problem+json with the members type, title, status, detail and instance.
A non-standard top-level member such as errors that a server adds to a problem document and that clients ignore when unknown.
The Spring Framework class that models the document, with a properties map that is written as top-level JSON members.
The parsed body of a failed response, which may be a problem document, text or null and must be checked before use.
A function returning body is ProblemDetail that narrows an unknown value to a known shape after checking it at run time.
An error returned by the submit action, attached to a field through fieldTree and cleared when the user edits that field.
A submission error without a fieldTree, which belongs to the whole form and is read from the root field.
